title: PowerPoint for Mac: customise the Presenter view layout
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap's planned capabilities, unchanged default layout and January 2027 target. Searches confirmed the reported feature-specific documentation gaps; minor corrections should add supporting citations and distinguish installing an update from Microsoft's staged feature rollout.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has no documentation page describing this new Presenter view layout feature.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Mac customize Presenter view layout reposition resize speaker notes text size minimum version layout saved devices. Read all returned excerpts and Office for Mac release notes; results concern slide editing, themes or unrelated controls, not this planned feature.

claims.claim: The Office for Mac release notes dated 4, 10 and 17 November 2026 list no Presenter view change.
claims.quote: Searched: Presenter and presenter in the fetched release notes for Office for Mac; no matches. Read November 4, 10 and 17 entries: November 4 restores Office 2021 functionality; November 10 lists Outlook features; PowerPoint entries report quality and performance improvements.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented where this new custom Presenter view layout is stored.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Mac customize Presenter view layout reposition resize speaker notes text size minimum version layout saved devices. Read returned excerpts and Office for Mac overview, release notes and per-app preferences; none states storage for this feature.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented whether the new custom layout follows presenters between devices.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Mac customize Presenter view layout reposition resize speaker notes text size minimum version layout saved devices. Read returned excerpts and Office for Mac release notes and preferences; none states whether this Presenter view layout roams between devices.

claims.claim: Speaker notes are part of the presentation file.
